statement: Free-text mapping rules fixed before clinician review and before truth.csv was joined.

v1.2_full.note: v1.1 held-out test (before cue rules): 70.2% auto-decided at 98.8% agreement. v1.2 figures are on all 1,370 strings, half of which were used for rule development.

review_design.must: low-confidence strings that were a primary answer
review_design.optional: low-confidence, differential only; blank keeps rule proposal
review_design.august_conflict: August mapping contradicted by high-confidence rule; blank keeps August
